title: doormats max 9
rule: Doormats: ≤9; heading 45 (max 75); description 120 keywords. Linked heading, no end punctuation. Descriptions = comma-separated keywords, not full sentences; no “Includes… / Information on… / Learn more about…”; no nested links, promo, bold, or bullets; no decorative icons. Don’t repeat Most-requested links. Semantic h2 “Services and information” may be visually hidden. Single-column when sequential tasks or heights would gap.
pass_when: ≤9 doormats; heading/description within those lengths; keyword descriptions; no nested links/promo/bold/bullets/decorative icons; no Most-requested repeats.
fail_when: 10+ doormats; sentence descriptions with “Learn more about…”; nested links or decorative icons; Most-requested duplicated.
overview: Canada.ca doormats cap at nine with short keyword headings and descriptions.
apply_when: Building a Services and information doormat block on Canada.ca.
not_when: Promotional feature tiles or Most-requested link lists elsewhere.
agent_hint: Limit doormats to nine; keyword descriptions; no promo, nested links, or icons.
